# CPython license source

`LICENSE.txt` is the unmodified license file from CPython `v3.12.14`:

https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.12.14/LICENSE

SHA-256: `6c4cb3ac7183d140222e754bbb81ae02c67a1cbe30352077358bca4b6c0f732a`

The desktop runtime builder uses this reviewed copy only when a Python 3.12
distribution does not install its own `LICENSE.txt`. Interpreter-provided
license files remain preferred because platform distributions can add
platform-specific terms.
